Online tarot card reading

Talk to an online tarot reader about a question you are sitting with — no birth details needed.

How it works

What to expect

Bring a question
Tarot works best on something specific — a decision, a relationship, a situation you are weighing up.
The spread is drawn
Your reader chooses a spread suited to the question and explains what each position represents.
Read together
Cards are discussed as themes and tendencies, not verdicts, and you can ask follow-up questions as you go.

What a tarot reading is for

A tarot card reading is a structured way of thinking through a question. The cards give a reader a framework — positions for what is behind a situation, what is in front of it, and what you may not be seeing — and the conversation that follows is where the value sits.

Unlike a Kundli reading, tarot needs no birth details, which makes it a common starting point for people who do not have an accurate birth time or who want to ask about one specific thing rather than about their life as a whole.

What it will not do

A reading is for reflection, not prediction of fixed outcomes. Readers on Astrowani are asked to frame a spread in terms of tendencies and choices. If you want a definite yes or no about a medical, legal or financial matter, a tarot reading is the wrong tool and a good reader will tell you so.

Frequently asked

Tarot Reading questions

Do I need to give my birth details for tarot?

No. A tarot reading works from your question, not from a birth chart. You can give your name and what you would like to ask about, and that is enough.

How long does an online tarot reading take?

Most readings run between ten and thirty minutes depending on the spread and how much you want to discuss. You are billed per minute and can end the session whenever you choose.

Can I ask about more than one question?

Yes, though a single clear question usually gives a more useful reading than several at once. Your reader will tell you if a question is too broad to spread for.
